criteria.name:
Include meta viewport on all pages
<meta content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" name="viewport"/>
Left align image credits, sources, and description link to long alt text
Font-size and line-height should be defined in relative units (em, %, or rem) for proper scaling.
No font sizes smaller than 10px, 7.5pt, 0.625em, 62.5%
All internal links have a 1:1 to backlink relationship
Visual cues: Links are visually distinct by using a contrast ratio of 3:1 with surrounding text

Bold and italic use <b> and <i> not fonts or <span> tags.
Italic and bolding in headers: If bold or italic styling is used in headings then CSS is used to style accordingly, no inline styling
Subscripts and superscripts done correctly with <sup> and <sub> markup

Use CSS Selectors to add visual styling to certain characters in a word. This ensures it will not affect assistive technology reading the entire word.
See example.

Use correct CSS styling used for all capitalized words. This should include any words that are entirely written in all caps.
See example.

MathML is consistent throughout the title. Each should contain proper MathML.
Note: Any math that is not captured as MathML should match the same alignment. Typically, this is center aligned.
Images generated from provided source files using G-W provided process.

Image file name format: Chapter number and figure number should be separated by a dash. Do not use a period.
Additionally, using the page number the figure is located on is acceptable.
criteria.resources:
Examples of acceptable file name:
01-01.jpg
…
01-01-03.jpg
…
fig2-36.jpg
…
fig2-2-1.jpg
…
p0004.jpg
…
p0009-01.jpg

criteria.name: Images at 150 dpi at a reasonable size and good quality for the EPUB file.

Images throughout the EPUB file include consistent dimensions and quality.
Images with a width dimension less than 500 pixels tend to be small and content appears unclear.
Images with a width dimension more than 1000 pixels tend to be large and can lead to longer load times.
*This excludes icons used in headers or asides
Repeating opener images are reduced to a single image linked throughout the content.
Figures heavily stylized should be captured as an image. Any text or callouts should be captured as long alt text.
INDD-built content that must be included in EPUB as an image match the visual quality of other processed images.
All images are tagged in the OPF file.
Include alt placeholder (alt="") on all image tags

Decorative image indicator: All decorative images were correctly identified and marked up correctly with alt="" and role="presentation"

Decorative images must have alt text. Repeated feature box icons can still be left as decorative.
Content is linked in the TOC (referencing toc.ncx file)
Content is linked in the navigation (referencing nav.xhtml file)
Figures are listed in the navigation. (referencing nav.xhtml file)
Content is linked in the index (referencing index.xhtml file)
Internal cross-references are linked ("Figure XX-XX", "unit X", "chapter X", "lesson XX-XX", etc.)
Do notlink external references in "Reference" or "Bibliography" sections of the text (for security and to reduce the likelihood of a broken link inside of the EPUB)
Text remains legible with embedded fonts turned off
Text remains legible at magnification up to 200%.

title, subtitle, source (print source ISBN), author (and any other creators as directed), edition, dc:identifier (EPUB ISBN), publisher, publication date, language, description, accessibility metadata, and rights

criteria.name: Index page formatted using unordered list tags
Key Terms found in the chapter opener: Should not include links to the key terms found in the content and glossary.

Key terms found in the content: Should include links to the glossary; the glossary should link back to the key term in the content.
If the Glossary terms include page numbers, include the link back to the content term in the page number.
If the Glossary term does not include page numbers, include the link back to the content term in the Glossary term.
Key terms within content are properly using <b> and <i> tags.
